title: Expose the scoped registry provider
verify: FT-007-AC-003: the accepted Center & Scheduling query returns complete read-only Students, Teachers, and Classes registry facts, including the I&A profile projection, institution, membership, parent, assignment, and counts.
Admin receives own-center rows, Teacher receives assigned-class rows, and Student/Parent center-wide access is denied without unrelated row existence or private-field leakage.
Provider output is serializable and read-only; routes and Lesson Context consume the public query rather than provider tables.
evidence_required: FT-007-AC-003 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: registry fields are incomplete, profile data crosses a direct table path, scope follows client input, or Student/Parent receives center-wide/private rows; GREEN: isolated provider RED/GREEN matrix proves complete read-only Students/Teachers/Classes facts, accepted Actor Context profile query, Admin/Teacher scope, and safe denial; artifact: .tasks/TASK-066-T3-FT-007-W30/ and .protocols/TASK-066-T3-FT-007-W30/.
purpose: Own the server-side registry payload, scope, and privacy boundary consumed by Statistics.
success_outcome: One Center & Scheduling public query returns the complete authorized registry facts without direct profile-table access or source mutation.
anti_goals: Do not implement UI sorting or route composition.
Do not read Identity & Access tables directly; use the accepted Actor Context profile query.
Do not mutate account, class, membership, attendance, payment, or allocation facts.
constraints: Center & Scheduling owns registry scope and center/class/membership/assignment facts.
Identity & Access owns fullName/registeredAt and is called only through the accepted Actor Context Boundary.
The provider is read-only and does not implement sorting or UI composition.
invariants: Admin scope is own Center and Teacher scope is assigned classes.
Student/Parent cannot obtain center-wide registry rows or private fields.
No provider query writes source facts or broadens scope from client input.
verification_targets: FT-007-AC-003: complete payload-field and role/scope matrix with guessed-route and removed-assignment negatives.
boundary-map.md#calendar-and-membership-query-boundary: provider owns registry facts and exposes one named query.
boundary-map.md#actor-context-boundary: profile fields cross only the accepted server boundary.

stop_conditions: Stop if registry data requires a new source-of-truth owner or a new public edge.
Stop if the provider must read Identity & Access tables directly, write another slice, or accept client scope as authority.
